maps.points.tower_level4.a02.title: Go downstairs → Tower Level 3
maps.points.tower_level4.detail: The familiar apparition takes shape before you.
maps.points.tower_level4.dialogue: "OF ALL MY COMPANIONS, NONE WAS MORE FAITHFUL."
maps.points.tower_level4.dialogue-3: "FOR MANY YEARS, HE REMAINED AT MY SIDE."
maps.points.tower_level4.dialogue-4: "BUT EVEN MY MAGIC COULD NOT TAME A DRAGON'S NATURE."
maps.points.tower_level4.dialogue-5: "SO I SET HIM FREE IN THE MOUNTAINS."
maps.points.tower_level4.dialogue-6: "THERE HE WOULD GUARD THE LAST KEY."
maps.points.tower_level4.dialogue-7: "I HOPED HE WOULD FIND PEACE... AND THAT NONE WOULD TROUBLE HIM."
maps.points.tower_level4.l01.detail: Caerlin Blue Bloom, Amberrose ×3, Crimsonspire Berries, Moonpetal, Solarbloom ×2, Mimic Heart
maps.points.tower_level4.l02.detail: Feather of Mercy, Medal of Balduran, Potion of Mega Healing, Potion of Forgetfulness
maps.points.tower_level4.name: Drop points on the map
maps.points.tower_level4.title: Memories of the giant dragon
